1) Who will be on your side for the 15-minute session? (Engineer, PM, or both)
2) Any specific use case you want us to prioritize — embeddings, low-latency inference, or cost optimization?

Hey Tessa — so sorry, got pulled into an emergency exec sync and missed this. Elena and I were planning to join briefly.

Would you be able to reopen a few options? We're interested in the latency/cost play for real-time features — would like the demo to show how Redwood performs at sub-100ms p95 on small batch sizes.

Apologies again — can we reschedule?

— Samir
VP Product, Skycraft AI

No worries, Samir — thanks for the heads up. Totally understand exec meetings happen. Quick options to get you back on track: 

- Fast reschedule (15 min): I have these immediate slots this week — Wed 7/18 9:30am PDT, Thu 7/19 11:00am PDT, Fri 7/20 2:15pm PDT. Reply with preferred slot and I’ll send the invite.
- Micro-slot (7 min): If you only want a sharp latency/cost snapshot we can do a 7-minute micro-walk with live numbers — Tue 7/17 10:00am or 3:30pm PDT.
- Async option: I can record a 7-minute demo focused on p95 latency on small batches and share a short runbook + a link to an on-demand test harness.

Attached: proposed-times-compact.csv (all availability), demo-quickstart-one-pager.pdf (what I’ll cover).

If you prefer, we can loop in Priyom to schedule a longer engineering deep-dive later this month.

Quick note: if low-latency is primary, please confirm target qps and average sequence length so I can surface the right model profile in the demo.

Thanks — Tessa
--
Tessa Morgan | SDR, Redwood Inference
Cal link: https://cal.redwood.ai/t/tessa/15

See you then — Samir
